Trump backs Flock AI cameras amid surveillance concerns

Former U.S. President Donald Trump expressed support for Flock's AI-powered surveillance cameras, stating "I like them." This backing comes as the company faces increasing scrutiny over its artificial intelligence and surveillance technology. Cities have begun canceling contracts with Flock, and some cameras have been vandalized. Lawyers reviewing the company's contracts have raised concerns about unclear data ownership policies. The company, valued at $8 billion, is backed by investors including a16z and Tiger Global.
